task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate the robot to the CUP, pick it up, navigate to the TABLE, and place the CUP on it.
assumptions: The CAR robot can safely navigate to the provided coordinates.
The coordinates of the CUP and TABLE are accessible.
rtdl: def task PickAndPlace(;){ state nav1_success: bool; state nav1_message: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_message: string; state nav2_success: bool; state nav2_message: string; state place_success: bool; state place_message: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=1.0; success->nav1_success, message->nav1_message); check(nav1_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP"; success->pick_success, message->pick_message); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=-2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=1.0; success->nav2_success, message->nav2_message); check(nav2_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP", location_name="TABLE"; success->place_success, message->place_message); check(place_success == true); } }
